title: 第19章 别再出洋相了第20章 我说什么来着
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
雨水化冰，这就是冰雹！
但这不应该啊！
昨天画的明明就是祈雨阵，怎么可能会出现这样极端的冰雹天气呢？
林楠立刻回想起了昨天画阵时的全过程。
先是核心的八卦。
阵图中的一笔一划，与脑海中的一模一样，不可能出现错误。
而后便是每一卦外附上的那些命令的绘制。
先是乾卦，三长，没错。
再是坎卦、艮卦……都没错啊，问题究竟出在哪里呢？
就在林楠皱眉紧张的思索之际，他突然想起了一件事！
前几日的日头很毒，而且一直没有雨水落下，空气又干燥又热，烤的大家十分不舒服，还有几名同学在军训时中暑晕倒。
于是他便想趁着这次完成祈雨建议的时候，让雨水多多滋润一下炎热的空气，让大家军训时能舒服一些。
所以在画这个九天元灵祈雨阵的时候，他意图将巽卦多出一笔，想让雨水下的稍微大一些。
但是却没有将对应水的坎卦多加一笔，反而将这一笔添在了坤卦之上！
也因此，本来他只想将降雨量增大，却意外的变成了，雨水即将停止之时，云层的水滴会瞬间凝固，进而形成冰雹的情况！
“祈雨阵还得练啊，一笔错，便有万千变化。”
林而且根据云层厚度的情况来看，这场冰雹还得持续一段时间。
暂时不知道冰雹的大小。
如果这冰雹不小的话，那么他们这些站在操场上的人，不都得被这冰雹蛋子给砸开瓢了？
意识到了情况的严峻，林楠的表情愈发的严肃起来。

不行！
得找个办法让现场的人先撤退才行！
他可不想因为自己的失误，造成任何人的受伤。
不然这因果自己可背不起！
“可，我说的话，会有人信吗？”
林楠有了一丝犹豫。
但是转念一想，管他呢！
如果不说，就一点机会都没有了。
自从扮神之后，林楠愈加信奉这些古老信仰，甚至因果报应的严重。
于是林楠回过神来，见校长正好停顿下来，立刻将手高高的举起，并且攒足了劲儿气沉丹田的喊道：
“报告！”
content_en:
Rain melts into ice, this is hail!
But this shouldn’t be the case!
The painting yesterday was obviously a rain praying formation, so how could such extreme hail weather happen?
Lin Nan immediately recalled the entire process of drawing the formation yesterday.
First, the core gossip.
Every stroke in the array diagram is exactly the same as the one in my mind, and there can be no mistakes.
Then comes the drawing of the commands attached to each hexagram.
The first is Qian Gua, three longs, that’s right.
Then there are the Kan and Gen hexagrams... They are all correct. What is the problem?
Just as Lin Nan was frowning and thinking nervously, he suddenly remembered something!
The sun has been very hot in the past few days, and there has been no rain. The air is dry and hot, which makes everyone very uncomfortable. Several students also fainted from heatstroke during military training.
So he wanted to take advantage of this time to complete the rain prayer suggestions, let the rain moisten the hot air, and make everyone feel more comfortable during military training.
So when he drew the Nine Heavens Yuanling Rain Praying Formation, he intended to add an extra stroke to the Sunda hexagram, hoping to make the rain fall a little harder.
But instead of adding an extra stroke to the Kan hexagram corresponding to water, this stroke was added to the Kun hexagram!
Therefore, originally he only wanted to increase the amount of rainfall, but unexpectedly, when the rain was about to stop, the water droplets in the clouds would solidify instantly, forming hailstones!
"You still have to practice the rain prayer formation. One mistake can lead to thousands of changes."
Lin and judging from the thickness of the clouds, this hailstorm will continue for some time.
The size of the hail is unknown at this time.
If the hail is not small, then those of them standing on the playground will be smashed open by the hail eggs?
Realizing the seriousness of the situation, Lin Nan's expression became more serious.
no!
We have to find a way to get the people on site to retreat first!
He didn't want to cause anyone to get hurt because of his mistake.
Otherwise, I won’t be able to bear the consequences!
"But, will anyone believe what I say?"
Lin Nan hesitated for a moment.
But then I thought about it, what the hell!
If you don't say it, there will be no chance at all.
Since pretending to be a god, Lin Nan has become more and more convinced of these ancient beliefs, and even the seriousness of karma.
So Lin Nan came back to his senses and saw the principal stopped. He immediately raised his hands high and shouted with all his strength:
"Report!"
